items.question: From which grade does the school admit students?
items.answer: Students are admitted from grade 1 through grade 11.

items.question: How does admission work?
items.answer: Students take a test in Mathematics and English and have an interview with the school psychologist. The pass mark is at least 60 points.

items.question: What tracks are offered in grades 10–11?
items.answer: Accounting and IT tracks, along with international ACCA and SAT programs. Graduates are guaranteed a minimum IELTS score of 5.5.

items.question: Are the clubs paid?
items.answer: No, all clubs (Mental Arithmetic, Chess, Arabic, Robotics, IT & Coding, Speech Therapy, Football, Judo) are free and included in the tuition fee.

items.question: How are meals organized?
items.answer: Students receive three meals a day — breakfast, lunch, and an afternoon snack — based on a specially prepared menu.

items.question: Is there a transport service?
items.answer: Yes, a school bus service is available for students commuting from afar.

items.question: How can tuition be paid?
items.answer: Tuition can be paid either annually or on a monthly basis.

items.question: Are there benefits for high-achieving students?
items.answer: Yes, students with high quarterly results study on a monthly scholarship basis.

items.question: Are there extra classes on Saturdays?
items.answer: Yes, students who are falling behind can attend Saturday catch-up classes: math and English in upper grades, and core subjects in primary grades.

items.question: How are the groups formed?
items.answer: Students are placed into A, B, and C groups by proficiency level. Groups are updated based on weekly assessment results.

items.question: What do graduates receive?
items.answer: Graduates are guaranteed an IELTS score of at least 5.5. Along with the school certificate, they receive a professional diploma.

items.question: What does the school day look like?
items.answer: Classes run on a five-day schedule, Monday to Friday, from 8:30 AM to 5:30 PM. Students have three meals during the day.

items.question: Do students wear a uniform?
items.answer: Yes, students wear the designated school uniform on campus.

items.question: In which language are primary grades taught?
items.answer: In grades 1–4, fundamental education is delivered in Russian- and Uzbek-medium groups.

items.question: Where is Ixlos School located?
items.answer: Ixlos School is located in Tashkent's Yunusabad district at Bog'ishamol ko'chasi, 219 (Toshkent, Yunusobod tumani, Bog'ishamol ko'chasi, 219-uy). Hours are 08:00–18:00; phone: +998 78 113 36 00.

items.question: Is Ixlos School a full-day school?
items.answer: Yes. Classes run Monday to Friday from 08:30 to 17:30. Students have three meals a day and attend free clubs after the main lessons; a school bus serves students who live far away.

items.question: How does admission to grade 1 work?
items.answer: Admission starts from grade 1. Like all other students, a first-grader takes a test in Mathematics and English and has an interview with the school psychologist; the pass mark is at least 60. Grades 1–4 have Uzbek- and Russian-medium groups.

items.question: Are mathematics and English taught in depth?
items.answer: Yes. In grades 5–9, mathematics, English and informatics are taught in depth. Students are placed in A, B and C groups by proficiency, and groups are updated after weekly exams. Graduates are guaranteed an IELTS score of at least 5.5.

items.question: Does the school teach IT and programming?
items.answer: Informatics is taught in depth in grades 5–9, and grades 10–11 offer an IT track that leads to a professional diploma. There is also a free IT and coding club after the main lessons.

items.question: What is the finance and accounting track?
items.answer: Grades 10–11 offer an Accounting track leading to a professional diploma, and the international ACCA program is taught as well. The school's founder holds the ACCA Diploma in International Financial Reporting and F1–F9 qualifications.

items.question: How much does tuition cost?
items.answer: Tuition depends on the grade level. It can be paid annually or monthly, and students with high quarterly results can study on a scholarship. For current prices, call +998 78 113 36 00 or leave an application.
